principle: The runtime may prescribe a general cognitive architecture and causal phase order, but must not prescribe concrete cognitive contents, subjective valence, social concepts or role conclusions.

graph_model.future_overlap: region assignment and cross-region bandwidth may evolve; later schemas may permit soft membership

routing.activation_phase: current inputs and retained state may affect current action potentials
routing.plasticity_phase: realized objective consequences may update only future state through bounded eligibility traces

objective_engine_facts: physical context and objective state delta
forbidden_concrete_cognition: fixed subjective valence for energy, integrity, resources, information or reproduction
fixed trust, friend, enemy, betrayal, cooperation or role semantics
fixed material, knowledge, protection or conflict benefit formulas
diagnostic labels fed back into behavior

implementation_stages.name: inert-schema-storage
implementation_stages.runtime_change: disabled path must be exactly neutral

implementation_stages.name: activation-routing
implementation_stages.runtime_change: generic graph may influence bounded action potentials

implementation_stages.name: objective-traces-delayed-plasticity
implementation_stages.runtime_change: later consequences may change future graph state without fixed valence

implementation_stages.name: developmental-variation-pruning-cost
implementation_stages.runtime_change: topology and capacities may evolve under explicit cost

implementation_stages.name: emergence-and-epoch-qualification
implementation_stages.runtime_change: scientific studies only after health qualification
